annotations.text:
REVIEW & LOCK — replaces the reflection moment

Arrives closed: five chapters, no scrolling. The whole page fits the viewport, sign-off included.

Each chapter is a verification unit. Verify opens every question in it — never a partial peek. Read it, hit "Looks right", it seals green and collapses. Five of five unlocks the button at the bottom.

This artboard is live — click it.

· Verify on any chapter opens all its questions
· Every question is its own card, with a rule between what was asked and what was answered
· Edit opens that one question; saving drops the chapter back to unverified so it has to be read again
· Lock it in stays inert until all five are verified
· Lock → the owl asks once → it locks and rolls straight into the Chapter III reflection handoff
Same rule on the phone: everything fits 390 × 844 on arrival. Open a chapter and each question stacks — asked on top, answered below a rule, Edit as a 44px target.
